problems.title: At least one prepared exam ticket
problems.question: A student knows 2 of 5 tickets in one exam and 3 of 6 in a second. Find the probability of a prepared ticket in at least one independent draw.
problems.idea: Use the complement of two unprepared tickets.

problems.title: A power with base one half
problems.question: Solve $(\cos(\pi/3))^{x-0.5}>\sqrt2$.
problems.idea: Write both sides as powers of 2.
formulas: cos(π/3)=1/2; powers with base 2 preserve exponent order.
steps: The left side is 2^(0.5-x) and the right side is 2^0.5.

problems.title: An exponential inequality becomes a quadratic
problems.question: Solve $2^{-2x-2.5}<(0.5)^{x^2+3x}/\sqrt2$.
problems.idea: Use the same positive base on both sides.

problems.title: Volume of a right triangular prism
problems.question: A right prism has right-triangle base area 12. Its greatest lateral face has area 7. The base has acute angle α with sin2α=0.75. Find its volume.
problems.idea: Find the base hypotenuse from its area and double angle.
formulas: Base area=ab/2; sin2α=2ab/c²; greatest lateral face=c·height.
steps: ab=24, so 0.75=48/c². Hence c²=64 and c=8.

problems.title: Angle between two skew cube lines
problems.question: M is the midpoint of AB in cube ABCDA₁B₁C₁D₁. Find the cosine of the acute angle between MD₁ and DB₁.
problems.idea: Use direction vectors; they need not meet.
formulas: cosθ=|u·v|/(|u||v|) for the acute angle between lines.
steps: The directions are u=(-1/2,1,1),v=(1,-1,1). Their dot product is -1/2.
The lengths are 3/2 and √3, so cosθ=(1/2)/[(3/2)√3]=1/(3√3).
problems.note: None of the printed choices equals this value for the named lines MD₁ and DB₁.

problems.title: A quadratic in an exponential
problems.question: Solve 9ˣ-2·3ˣ<3.
problems.idea: Let t=3ˣ>0.
steps: Since t>0, this reduces to t<3.

problems.title: Count intersections inside a short interval
problems.question: How many intersections have y=1-3cosx and y=cosx-1 for -2≤x≤2?
problems.idea: Equate the y-values.
steps: They give two different intersection points.

problems.title: A decreasing common exponential base
problems.question: Solve (cosα)^(1/x)>[sin(π/2-α)]ˣ, where -π/2<α<π/2 and α≠0.
problems.idea: Both bases equal a number strictly between zero and one.
steps: The domain excludes x=0. The exponent condition is 1/x<x.
A sign chart at -1,0,1 gives (-1,0) and (1,∞).

problems.title: A nonnegative square root always exceeds a negative number
problems.question: Solve $\sqrt{1/2-\cos x}>-1/2$.
problems.idea: The inequality holds at every point of the radical’s domain.
formulas: A real square root is nonnegative.
steps: On that domain the left side is ≥0>-1/2, including where it equals zero.
Thus x lies from π/3 to 5π/3 in every full turn.

problems.title: An obtuse angle from a negative dot product
problems.question: For which x do a=(0,-2,2),b=(-x,x,3) form an obtuse angle?
problems.idea: The vectors are always nonzero.
formulas: An obtuse vector angle has u·v<0.

problems.title: Greatest integer satisfying a base-ratio inequality
problems.question: Find the greatest integer solution of 5^(2x-1)>3^(4x-2).
problems.idea: The right exponent is twice 2x-1.
steps: Because 0<5/9<1, its exponent must be negative: 2x-1<0.
Thus x<1/2, whose greatest integer is 0.

problems.title: Where a radical denominator is undefined
problems.question: Find all x for which $\sin x/\sqrt{\pi^2-x^2}$ is undefined.
problems.idea: The denominator’s radicand must be strictly positive.
steps: The expression is defined exactly when π²-x²>0, giving -π<x<π.
Its undefined set is the complement, including both endpoints.

problems.title: Lateral area from the volume of an equal-edge hexagonal prism
problems.question: All edges of a regular hexagonal prism are equal. Its volume is V. Find its lateral area.
problems.idea: Express both quantities through the common edge a.

problems.title: A zero product with nested radicals
problems.question: Find the smallest positive root of $(\cos x+\sin x-6)(1-\sqrt[4]{2\sqrt{\sin x}})=0$.
problems.idea: The first factor cannot vanish, so solve the second on its domain.
steps: The domain requires sinx≥0. Since √2<6, the first factor is never zero.
The second requires ⁴√(2√sinx)=1, hence 2√sinx=1 and sinx=1/4.
The smallest positive root is arcsin(1/4).
problems.note: This value is absent from the printed choices. The fourth root and the inner square root must both be respected.

problems.title: An exponential substitution with a sign restriction
problems.question: Solve $\sqrt{5^x-1}=7-5^x$.
problems.idea: Set t=5ˣ and use both sides’ domain signs.

problems.title: A box vector with a downward reference direction
problems.question: In rectangular box ABCDA₁B₁C₁D₁, AM:MB=2:5. Given A₁A=a,A₁B₁=b,A₁D₁=c, express MD₁.
problems.idea: Use A₁ as the vector origin.
formulas: A division point at ratio 2:5 is 2/7 of the way from A to B.
steps: A has vector a, B has vector a+b, so M=a+(2/7)b.

problems.title: Sine of a regular tetrahedron’s dihedral angle
problems.question: All edges of a regular triangular pyramid are equal. Find the sine of a dihedral angle along a lateral edge.
problems.idea: Cut perpendicular to the edge through its midpoint.
formulas: An equilateral face altitude is a√3/2; cosine rule in the perpendicular section.
steps: The two opposite vertices are a apart, while each is a√3/2 from the midpoint of the common edge.
The cosine of the section angle is [2(3a²/4)-a²]/[2(3a²/4)]=1/3.

problems.title: Volume of an equilateral-base prism from its circumradius
problems.question: A regular triangular prism has height 8 cm and base circumradius 2 cm. Find its volume.
problems.idea: Convert the equilateral circumradius to its side.

problems.title: Half-angle squares and a large rational multiple of π
problems.question: Evaluate $[(1+\cot^2(\pi/8))^{-1}+\cos^2(2015\pi/12)]/0.5$.
problems.idea: Use the reciprocal identity and reduce the squared cosine modulo π.
problems.note: None of the printed choices has this exact combination of signs.

problems.title: Minimize a quadratic over an exponential range
problems.question: Find the minimum of y=9^(cos²x)-4·3^(cos²x)+2.
problems.idea: Set t=3^(cos²x), whose range is [1,3].
steps: The quadratic minimum is -2 at t=2.
This value is allowed because 2∈[1,3], corresponding to cos²x=log₃2∈[0,1].

problems.title: Box volume and two diagonal angles
problems.question: A rectangular box’s base diagonals form a 30° angle. Its volume is 2 cm³, and a space diagonal makes 45° with the base. Find its height.
problems.idea: Express base area through its diagonal length.
steps: Let the base diagonal be d. The base area is (1/2)d²sin30°=d²/4.
Then V=d³/4=2, so d³=8 and d=h=2.

problems.title: Square area from opposite vertices in space
problems.question: Opposite square vertices are A=(1,-2,3),C=(-1,2,-3). Find its area.
problems.idea: The diagonal length determines the square area even in three dimensions.

problems.title: Displaced volume raises an aquarium’s water level
problems.question: An aquarium has base 40 by 60 cm. A fully submerged stone has volume 240 cm³. By how many millimetres does the water rise?
problems.idea: Divide the displaced volume by the horizontal base area.
formulas: Height rise=displaced volume/base area; 1 cm=10 mm.

problems.title: Probability in a square cut by two inequalities
problems.question: x,y are independent and uniform on [0,2]. Find P(x+y>2 and y<x+1).
problems.idea: Use the area of the intersection inside the 2-by-2 square.
formulas: Uniform probability=favourable area/total area; triangle area=base·height/2.
steps: The region x+y>2 is a triangle of area 2.
Within it, the excluded region y≥x+1 is the triangle with vertices (0,2),(1,2),(1/2,3/2). Its area is 1·(1/2)/2=1/4.
The favourable area is 2-1/4=7/4. Divide by the square area 4 to get 7/16.

problems.title: Solve an equation involving two counting formulas
problems.question: Solve 4C(y,4)=15A(y,2) for an integer y in the counting formulas’ domain.
problems.idea: Expand both formulas and cancel only factors known to be nonzero.
steps: After substitution and cancellation of positive y(y-1), the equation is (y-2)(y-3)/6=15.
Only y=12 belongs to the required integer domain y≥4.
